thread:
Sasha: thinking about adding an "amortized cold-start" line to the per-model econ card — shows 7d GPU warmup cost spread across invocations + cache-savings allocated back to routes. would help teams see hidden warmup costs :thinking:
Tom: love the idea. question: do we attribute warmup to model sku or to calling route? both have tradeoffs for chargebacks and incentives.
Leah: prefer attributing to the route that triggered the warmup (first-owner) — otherwise infra/ops will soak a lot of noise. we did first-owner for prefetch credits and it was intuitive.
Mike: +1 for first-owner but we need provenance to recompute if routing changes. emit a cold_start_event id in telemetry and include the triggering invocation id.
Sasha: telemetry plan: add `cold_start_id` to invocation events, `model_warmup` events with fields: amortization_window_s, warmup_cost_usd, warmup_duration_s. console joins by cold_start_id to produce amortized lines.
Tom: how bad are the join costs for the dashboard? we render many econ cards on a single page for big orgs.
Leah: don’t let the UI hit raw events. pre-aggregate into a materialized rollup table. rough nightly SQL (for discussion):
```sql
INSERT INTO econ_rollup_daily (date, model_id, route_id, warmup_cost_usd, warmup_invocations, cache_savings_usd)
SELECT current_date as date, w.model_id, i.route_id, SUM(w.warmup_cost_usd), COUNT(DISTINCT i.id), SUM(s.savings_usd)
FROM model_warmup w
JOIN invocation i ON i.cold_start_id = w.cold_start_id
LEFT JOIN cache_savings s ON s.invocation_id = i.id
WHERE w.ts >= current_date - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY w.model_id, i.route_id;
```
Mike: that looks good. then expose a compact read API so console can request `GET /console/econ/models/{model_id}/routes?window=7d&adjust=cache` — server returns aggregated numbers and tiny sparklines.
Sasha: UI mock: tiny sparkline for amortized warmup next to tok/cost sparkline, a pill toggle for "cache-adjusted" vs "raw" totals. default to cache-adjusted. add tooltip copy explaining amortization.
Tom: ux note: teams will mistake amortized for recurring overhead. tooltip: "This spreads one-time warmup cost across invocations in the selected window; it is an estimate and may not recur."
Leah: rollout plan: behind a console feature flag. sample-mode for telemetry validation — show estimates for 5% of models. run a small A/B: variant A shows model-sku attribution, variant B shows route attribution so we can measure clarity and chargeback disputes.
Mike: infra-bot: can we add an alert when warmup_cost_usd / total_cost_usd > 0.20 for any route? signal for model pinning or proactive prewarming.
infra-bot: alert rule created: `econ.warmup_ratio > 0.2` scoped to route_id, evaluate every 30m, cooldown 6h.
Sasha: open question: cache savings split when multiple routes share cached prefixes. current thought: split pro rata by token_delta or by time-in-cache; token_delta seems easiest and more aligned to econ. add `kv_cache_hit_tokens` and `kv_cache_miss_tokens` to invocation telemetry so we can compute per-invocation benefit.
Tom: API compatibility: adding fields to invocation events is backward-compatible if we bump telemetry schema minor version. need migration doc for older consumers.
Mike: ops action list:
- sasha: create console mock + tooltip copy (due in 2d)
- leah: spec telemetry fields + draft rollup SQL + sample query (due EOD)
- tom: perf estimate for rollup query + memory & index needs (due 3d)
- mike: implement read API + wire alert (due 4d)
Sasha: i'll open the feature-flag PR and a 5% canary for models once telemetry and rollup land. thanks all :thumbsup:
